sections.title: GM13 Thread Catalog
sections.text: Lists and queries a curated ISO metric coarse table (M3..M24) with major/minor/pitch diameters and lead. lead = starts * pitch; turns-per-length is a separate quantity (1/lead). This is a curated subset, not the full installed Fusion thread table; exact native identifiers still need native discovery.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, system, curated:true, entries[] (designation, majorDiameter, pitch, pitchDiameter, minorDiameter, starts, lead, hand) and a note about the curated subset. status pass.

examples.label: Query M10 coarse
examples.output: result.entries has one entry with pitch 1.5 mm and lead 1.5 mm (single start).

bugs: Curated subset only; full installed table not enumerated

sections.title: GM13 Custom Thread Profile
sections.text: Defines and validates a custom (non-tabular) thread profile from majorDiameter, pitch, and either minorDiameter or pitchDiameter. starts gives lead = starts * pitch; hand right/left; flankAngle and rootShape describe the tooth. length, runout and clearance are optional. The result is a BRep recipe, never a visual texture.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, profile (major/minor/pitch diameters, pitch, starts, lead, depth, turnsPerLength, flankAngle, rootShape, length, runout, clearance), representation:recipe and the explicit lead definition note.

examples.label: M10x1.5 custom profile
examples.output: result.profile.lead is 1.5 mm and result.profile.depth is (major-minor)/2.

verified: lead = starts * pitch and diameter ordering
Custom profile is a recipe, never texturized

sections.title: GM13 Thread Pair Check
sections.text: Checks an external (bolt) and internal (nut) thread pair: hand match, lead match (within tolerance), starts match, radial fit and positive engagement depth. lead equality alone is not enough; starts must also match. This is a geometric fit check, not a torque/preload or sealing certification.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, external/internal profiles, checks[] (hand, lead, starts, radial-fit, engagement-depth), pairFit, engagementDepth and crossSection. status pass or fail.

examples.label: M10x1.5 RH bolt into nut
examples.output: result.pairFit is pass; result.engagementDepth is (external major - internal minor)/2.

verified: Hand, lead and starts all match for engagement
